items.title: Artificial Id: Drive and Persistent Alignment in Agentic AI
items.summary: Agentic AI is moving from bounded task execution toward systems that retain consequential state, continue operating and adapt across task boundaries. That shift creates a control problem that current harnesses largely solve by hand: objectives, retries, verification, stopping rules and other behavioral transitions are specified externally. items.title: From Protocols to Evidence: Bounded Claims for AI in Service of the Common Good
items.summary: Artificial Intelligence does more than create a governance problem. items.title: From Specs to Apps: Verifying and Monitoring Models of Signal and WhatsApp
items.summary: The Signal protocol is a prominent messaging protocol that secures communication for billions of users. It powers WhatsApp, the most widely used messaging application worldwide, and the Signal app, popular among privacy-conscious users. Extensive research in the computational and Dolev-Yao settings provides strong formal security guarantees for the protocol itself. items.title: Biology-in-the-loop: Amortized Adaptive Hit Discovery in CRISPR Screens
items.summary: Many biological discovery problems require experiments to be selected sequentially under constrained budgets.
